Commentary.Commentary: Alright then. 242 to win. Who is your money on? This should be one spicy run chase. Stay tuned.

Rassie van der Dussen is giving an interview to Mark Nicholas. Rassie says that it is a bit of a sticky wicket given that there has been two weeks of rain around. Adds that it is not a 300 pitch and hence the batsmen were planning to reach 250-260. Admits that the team has its back to the wall, so has to bowl well today.

Good bowling by New Zealand on a sluggish pitch, except Boult. He was the only one struggling for rhythm throughout the innings while the others did reasonably well. Lockie Ferguson was the pick of the bowlers, picking up 3 wickets and if you leave out his last over which went for 15, he had the Saffas rattled.

After a 90-minute delay, South Africa began their batting on a sluggish pitch very cautiously, struggling to adapt to the conditions. De Kock went early but what will disappoint the Proteas more is that three batsmen in the top four got starts but could not convert those. There were three half century stands in the innings. Amla took a long time to get going but then was dismissed for 55. Same for Miller, who departed just when he looked to pull the trigger. Only van der Dussen hung in till the end, finishing on a fine unbeaten 67.

Hmmm... 241 then. That in-between score where a team can never be sure 100 percent how to plan its approach. On paper, this looks short. But given how the pitch has behaved, this might just be enough.
FOUR! 10 runs off the final two balls and South Africa finish on 241/6. A length ball outside off, van der Dussen hammers this straight back down the ground and splits long on and long off!
SIX! Third one for van der Dussen. A short ball, outside off, Rassie gets hold of this one and clubs the pull over long on!
Outside off, Rassie looks to swing hard but misses.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one. One run added to the total.
A short ball outside off, Morris is beaten by pace as he looks to pull. Misses.
FOUR! A bit fortuitous. A short ball, around middle, Morris looks to pull but gets a top edge. It flies over the keeper to the fence behind.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Outside off, RvdD looks to slog but misses.
A slower ball, fuller in length, van der Dussen looks to slog but is done in by the lack of pace. The ball hits the inside edge and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Slower ball, pulled down to long on for a run. That was mistimed.
DROPPED! That was a sitter. A short ball, around middle, Rassie pulls this towards long leg. Lockie Ferguson comes running in and should have gobbled a sitter but puts it down. A single taken.
SIX! How has that gone all the way? A short ball, around middle, van der Dussen looks to pull but the ball hits the inner half of the bat. Still the ball clears square leg.
Matt Henry to bowl the 48th over. 9-2-26-0 so far. Can he get a wicket in his final over?

Almost drags it on! Third consecutive slower delivery. A short ball, outside off, Morris looks to pull but gets a bottom edge which just misses the stumps. It goes behind and Latham quickly gets to the ball, has an under-arm shy at the stumps seeing Morris wander out but misses.
A short one now, Chris backs away and looks to slash hard but misses again.
Outside off, on a length, Morris plays inside the line and is beaten.
Chris Morris comes in now, surprisingly after Andile, when it should have been the other way round.

OUT! Caught of a full toss. Tell you, this ball is making waves in this tournament. Forget the yorkers. Forget the bouncers. The full toss is the way to go. Pun intended. This is outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to go over mid off but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and lobs to mid off. Simple catch for Kane Williamson who back-tracks at that position.
A slower ball, short in length, Andile looks to pull but misses. The ball goes over the stumps.
WIDE. A short ball, Phehlukwayo looks to hook but misses.
A short ball, around middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Backs away down the leg side, Boult follows him and Andile cannot do anything. Good diving stop by Tom Latham to his right. A very unlikely bowling spell by Trent Boult. 10-0-63-1 today.

Ouch. That pain. Rassie is wincing. Full and around off, RvdD drives it down the ground but this time long off cuts it off. A single taken. There was a jarring effect when the batsman played that shot.
FOUR! Powerful strike! Full and around off, van der Dussen hammers it straight back past the bowler and splits long on and long off!
A problem here for Rassie van der Dussen. The physio has come out to check his thumb. South Africa do not want another injury, do they?
OUCH. That has hurt. A short ball, on middle and off, van der Dussen looks to pull but the extra bounce does him in. Hits him on his thumb and then onto his arm and then his chest. He is in pain.
Down the leg side, Andile looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, fuller in length, Phehlukwayo has a slash but misses.
A short ball, on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple. 12 runs but a wicket as well from the over. Ferguson's figures read 8-0-42-2.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks in next, at number 7, replacing Miller.

OUT! In the air, in the air, in the air and taken! New Zealand have got the killer, which might help them evade death. A short ball, outside off, slower in pace, Miller leaps and looks to play the upper cut. He mistimes it and the result is a top edge which flies down towards third man. Trent Boult runs to his left and looks to take the catch with his cupped in reverse fashion. Almost lets it through but manages to hang on. Flashback 2003 World Cup  final - anyone remembers the catch Virender Sehwag took to dismiss Adam Gilchrist at deep mid-wicket? That one too, nearly went through his fingers. Big wicket for the Kiwis. 250 might be difficult now.
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a run.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Badly lined and it brings up consecutive boundaries for the Proteas. Full and down the leg side, Miller flicks it to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! SLAP! Oh yes. Miller is on the charge. Watch out, New Zealand. Short ball, around middle and leg, David swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Lockie Ferguson is back on. 7-0-30-1 so far.
Banged in short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run. 11 from the over. Has Miller given the signal for the surge?

SIX! There goes Killer Miller! In his arc and out of the park. Normally, his arc covers mid on and mid off but this one is a bit wider. Full and on middle, Miller swings it clean as a whistle over mid-wicket!
Outside off, punched off the back foot for one more.
A short ball, pulled away to mid-wicket. Santner has a shy at the bowler's end  but misses. A quick run taken.

SAFE. On middle, Miller pushes it towards cover. There is a yes-yes and a no-no and eventually, van der Dussen has to dive back in. The throw comes to Boult who leaps and disturbs the stumps and it is taken upstairs. Replays show that Rassie is in.
Is that a run out? It was an awful mix-up and umpire Ian Gould has taken it upstairs. Replays are indicating that van der Dussen is in.
A length ball, on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. That one rocketed away.
Trent Boult again. 8-0-47-1 so far. Could this possibly be his last over? Or will he get his 10th?
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
A short ball, another pull shot played, aerially wide of short mid-wicket, for one. 50-RUN STAND IS UP.
Full and outside off, punched down to long off for a run.
A short ball, DM looks to pull but misses.
Outside off, short in length, Miller looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which rolls to the off side.
A short ball, down the leg side, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Rassie reaches out and punches it with the turn through the covers for one. 10 from the over.
Eases this a bit straighter, down the ground to long off for a run.
Comes down the track and drives but finds cover.
Flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! First one of the innings! What a contrast as compared to what happened at Old Trafford yesterday. Rassie has had enough of Santner's flight. Finally looks to go downtown, getting down on a knee and sending it flying over long on!
Full and outside leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket. Van der Dussen wants the second but it isn't there and he is sent back.
A bouncer to end the over, van der Dussen allows it to sail through.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Drives it through the covers for a single.
Comes down the track, looks to pull but misses. Is hit on the left shoulder and the batsmen take a leg bye.
A length ball outside off, Miller slashes hard but misses.
Full and down the leg side, van der Dussen tickles it towards fine leg for a single.
Matt Henry comes back into the attack. 7-2-19-0 so far. Looks to be one of the bowlers who will complete his quota of 10 overs.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for one more.
Full and around off, driven past the bowler towards long off for a run.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Rassie looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end. Mitchell Santner to inaugurate it. 7-0-32-1 so far.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.

A terrific yorker, around middle and leg, Miller slips, loses his balance but manages to flick it through mid-wicket! Once again Colin Munro manning that area gets to the ball and slides to his right, stopping the ball. Two runs taken. 3000 ODI runs for Miller. The 17th Saffa to do so.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.

Excellent stop by Colin Munro. Full and outside off, van der Dussen crashes it through the covers and the ball races away. But Munro rushes to his right from sweeper cover, dives and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
Trent Boult returns. 7-0-40-1 so far. Not the Boult we know so far. Can he make up for it in his remaining overs?
A yorker, outside leg, Miller misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short mid-wicket.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, David cannot put that away. Misses his flick.
Around off, punched back down the ground back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball, outside leg, Miller looks to defend but the ball kicks off the surface and hits him on the glove, dropping down to the off side.
Full and fast, outside leg, Miller looks to flick but like the others, is early into his shot. The leading edge is induced which lands short of cover.
Landed outside off, tapped to the off side for a quick run. De Grandhomme is done for the day. 10-0-33-1.
A short ball, pulled towards mid-wicket for one.
Landed outside off, blocked towards point.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, helped towards fine leg for a run.

In the air... safe. A slower ball from de Grandhomme, just 118 kph, Miller is early into his chip shot but just about clears mid on. Matt Henry runs after it, gets to the ball and then slides near the ropes to pull the ball back. Three runs taken.
A slower ball, short in length, Miller looks to fend it away but is beaten due to the lack of pace. Is hit on the left bicep and the ball deflects towards point. A leg  bye taken.

Direct hit would have had Rassie. He punches this wide of mid off and takes the fielder on. He takes a few steps to his left, does the fielder, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Rassie was a centimeter short.
Fuller in length this time, driven straight to mid on.
Outside off, tapped straight to point.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

JUST MISSES THE STUMPS! A nervy moment for van der Dussen. Outside off, on a length, Rassie looks to punch but the ball takes the bottom edge. Bounces and just goes over the stumps. A quick single taken.
Lockie Ferguson is back on. 5-0-24-1 so far.
Flicks this away for a run.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, worked through square leg for a couple.
Outside off, dabbed to third man.
Just over mid off! A length ball outside off, van der Dussen looks to go over the top but mistimes it. Mid off runs back to catch it but cannot get there. Two runs taken.

DRINKS BREAK. South Africa might have to take solace from the fact that they are batting first on this pitch. They simply would not have had any chance in a run chase. The batsmen are simply not getting used to the pitch and are struggling to time the ball. Though, this is one point of view. This is certainly not a 300-plus pitch but what is a good score here? 6 an over from here takes the Proteas close to 240. Can they get there? Will that be good enough? The final phase of the innings begins.
Full and swinging down, David misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Flicks this away for one.
Landed outside off, Miller opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a run.
On middle and off, pushed straight to mid on.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
David Miller is in next. South Africa need him to be the Killer Miller today.

OUT! Caught in the deep! So Markram is not a cat with 9 lives. After being given a few lives, he eventually gets out, without making much use of those. A length ball, down the leg side, 126 kph, Markram is down the track to go over the top but is done in by the lack of pace. He is early into the shot and hence gets a leading edge. It carries all the way to sweeper cover where Colin Munro comes running in and takes it reverse cup. Risky attempt, as it was near his waist. Markram falls for just 38.

Hola Wimbledon! The championships are set to begin sometime in July, but Markram is promoting it from now itself. A super slow short ball, Aiden is down the track but has to wait, wait and wait for the ball to arrive. He eventually gets the ball in his area, leaps and then smashes a forehand pull, but finds mid on.
Outside off, tapped behind point for a single.
On middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
WIDE. A wayward bouncer, down the leg side.

Oops! Another lucky moment for Aiden Markram! Would have really been an unlucky dismissal. Full and straight, driven straight back. Boult dives to his right, but misses the ball. It hits the stumps and then umpire Ian Gould who was trying to avert it. Mid on mops it up. Had Boult got a hand to it, Markram would have been going back.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
He is opening up now. Full and wide outside off, Aiden throws his bat at this one and hammers it through the covers but there is insurance at sweeper. Just a run.
FOUR! That has been punished. Wide half volley outside off, Markram leans and drives it through the covers.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
You dropped the catch, now you only get the wicket. Looks like this is the message from Kane Williamson. Trent Boult has been given the ball. 5-0-29-1 so far.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards cover.
Down the leg side, AM looks to pull but misses. The ball hits his thigh pads and rolls past the keeper through fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
Full and around off, Aiden looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. De Grandhomme appeals but there was wood involved.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. They pick up a single.
Outside off, driven uppishly towards mid off. Does not carry.

IN THE AIR, BUT PUT DOWN! Ohh... Trent Boult, off all the people! The man who has defied gravity in the past, cannot quite take a sitter this time around. It is a short ball, around middle and leg, Markram pulls it away but it is going almost straight to the man at long leg. Boult has to cover a small distance to his left and he does so, gets to the ball, looks to take the catch but at the last moment, jumps. Don't know why. The ball hits his palms and then goes down. Two runs taken. Is this the fortune which South Africa needed?
Colin de Grandhomme returns. 6-0-17-0 so far.
Around off, solidly defended.
Down the leg side, could have been left alone, would have been wided but van der Dussen tickles it fine. Two runs taken.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.

FOUR! LOVELY! Bit of King Kallis in that shot. The long levers, the opening of the chest and the extension of the arms. Beautiful to watch. Tossed up outside off, Markram leans and drives it uppishly, wide of cover, for a boundary!
Landed outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and arrowed in on leg stump, pushed towards cover for a quick single.
Turns this length ball straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On a length ball outside off, Rassie punches it through covers for one.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.

A short ball, on middle, Markram is hurried into the pull shot. Mistimes it and the ball lobs in the air. Just wide of short mid-wicket. A run taken. Lockie is rattling the batsmen with his pace here.

On a good length outside off, cutting in sharply, van der Dussen looks to flick but misses and is hit on the thigh pad. He does not know where the ball is and does a 360 degree rotation before understanding that it has gone to point. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single. 4 runs and a wicket from the over, Santner's figures read 6-0-24-1.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Rassie van der Dussen walks in at number 5, replacing Amla.

OUT! BOWLED! Santner has his man! He was pegging and pegging and pegging away and eventually gets the Mighty Hash. Amla looks to defend a straight ball but is beaten by the dip in flight. That is what such balls do, when they are flighted over the eyeline. It lands around leg, bounces, spins away and hits the top of off stump. A true spinner's delight. Superb. Amla's struggles are over.
Dropped short, pulled through square leg for a run.

Another risky shot. Markram is looking a touch fidgety out there. Comes down the track, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball as it is fired down the leg side and luckily for him, he manages to get bat to it to flick it towards fine leg. By the time short fine leg can get across, two runs taken. 50-RUN STAND IS UP!
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler on the front foot.

IN THE AIR... JUST SHORT! A bit risky from Markram. Short and outside off, Aiden leaps and cuts it uppishly towards point. Martin Guptill at point dives forward but the ball lands just short. Hits his palm and then rolls behind. A run taken.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
WIDE. A slower bouncer, but way down the leg side and too high as well. Left alone.
Outside off, tapped with soft hands through the covers for a quick run.

Sairaj the inquisitive man - Wonder how is this slow-play going to help South Africa. Let's say if it rains and DLS comes into play, their run-rate is certainly going to be an issue. @Sairaj - Nice tag to your name, by the way. Going by their slow approach, this pitch does not look to be a 350 one. It is more of the 250-260 type and the Proteas are keeping wickets in hand for a late flourish. The forecast is predicted to be sunny later on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Outside off, flashed through point for a couple.
Lockie Ferguson is back. 3-0-16-1 so far. He will be looking for a wicket again.
Outside off again, punched wide of the bowler towards long off for a run.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed uppishly back to the bowler.
Full on middle and off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Half century for Amla! His first in his last 9 World Cup innings. What a relief for him. Looks at the heavens and then raises his bat to the crowd and the dressing room. Sluggish but important knock. Gets there in dramatic fashion, whipping this aerially, just wide of Matt Henry at mid on who dived to his right but missed it.
Around off, HA whips it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and outside off, Amla punches it straight to point. Hashim is consuming a lot of balls here.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Stunning shot. Full and around middle, Markram drives it straight back to where it came from.
Full on middle and leg, pushed uppishly back to the bowler. Almost carries!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.

RUN OUT MISSED! Nearly a suicide committed by Markram. He pushes this towards long on and 'ASSUMES' that the ball is past short mid-wicket. Wrong. Very wrong. When the fielder is a Kiwi, you can never assume anything. Because contrary to their name, these Kiwis can fly. And this man is a Superman. Kane Williamson. He swoops onto the ball to his left, stops for a second, gets up and then has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses. Markram was gone for all money even with a dive. Santner did not collect it either.
Full and around off, driven down to long on for a single.
Good running. Aiden flicks it through mid-wicket and runs hard to come back for the second.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.

Interesting. Markram is wanting to make a statement and get a move on. Walks down the track and tries to manufacture a shot. However, he does not get to the pitch of the ball and misses his flick. The ball hits his pads and de Grandhomme appeals but the umpire moves away. Probably going down the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Pushes this wide of mid on for a quick single.
Outside off, played towards point again.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a quick run.
Similar ball, same reaction.
Full and around off, watchfully defended with a front face of the bat.
Outside off, tapped towards cover for a single.
On middle, punched off the back foot for a single.
Outside off, flayed through the covers for a run.
Outside off, on a length, punched down the ground back to the bowler.
Outside off, tapped towards point.
Around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Amla gets across and wristily flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, driven straight to mid on.
Another watchful forward defense to end the over.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

The arm ball, sliding in, Amla waits for the ball to come and guides it behind point for a quick single. Colin de Grandhomme returns a wild throw towards the keeper, who dives to his right but still cannot stop it. Luckily for them, there is short fine leg backing up.
Bit of extra flight on this one, outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
On middle, punched off the back foot for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Bit of lateral movement, pitched outside off, coming in a long way, Markram misses his flick and is hit on the pads. No appeal this time.
Outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Outside off, flashed behind point for a single.

Huge shout for LBW! Turned down. Williamson has a long chat with the keeper and his bowler but does not take the review. On a good length outside off, nipping back a long way in, Amla misses his flick and is hit on the pads. De Grandhomme roars but Llong cuts it short. Probably too high and also sliding down. Replays confirm it was umpire's call. Clipping the leg stump.
Full and just around off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for one.
Outside off, a tad fuller, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
A tad short, punched down to long on for a run.
Landed outside off, punched wide of long off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Also, spinner into the attack for the first time today. Mitchell Santner to roll his arm over.

Drinks Break! New Zealand have got two big wickets of de Kock and du Plessis and at the same time they have managed to curtail the runs as well. All four bowlers used so far have bowled well. For South Africa, Hashim Amla has taken his time but is looking good out in the middle. He is joined by Markram and these two will have to steady the ship at a good rate here.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, it shapes away after pitching. Markram looks to drive but misses.
Fuller on middle, Amla looks to drive it towards mid on but gets it off the upper half of his bat. The ball goes to the left of mid on and they get a single.
De Grandhomme pulls his length back on off, Amla cuts it but finds the man at point.
Full around off, Amla is late into his push but he manages to hit it off the toe end towards mid on.
Fuller now on off, Hashim defends it towards mid off.
Good length ball on the fourth stump line, Amla leaves it alone. The ball reaches Latham on a bounce.
Typical fast bowler's response after being hit for a boundary. Lockie bangs it in short, Markram sways out of it.
FOUR! Markram is off the mark and in a gorgeous fashion. Length delivery on off, Markram's eyes lit up looking at that and he crunches his drive through covers for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle, Markram flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Amla drives it towards covers where Mitchell Santner goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it. It hits Amla's bat in the process. The batsmen cross ends.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Amla looks to cut but misses it.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Amla lets it go.
Good length ball on the fourth stump line, Aiden leaves it alone to see off the over.
Outside off, Markram shoulders arms to this one.
Full on off, Markram drives it uppishly towards point. The fielder there dives to his left but the ball gets to him on the bounce.
Peach of a ball! Good length ball outside off, it comes in slightly after pitching, Markram looks to play but misses.
Fuller on off, Amla drives it towards cover and gets a single.
Good length ball outside off, Amla leaves it alone.
Also, Colin de Grandhomme is introduced into the attack.
Aiden Markram walks out to bat next.

OUT! Ferguson strikes! Faf who was looking so good out in the middle has to depart. Ferguson steams in and bowls a perfect yorker on middle and off, du Plessis is late to get his bat down and the ball hits the stumps. Faf was looking good out in the middle and he had taken his time to settle in but he cannot make the most of it. Ferguson has given Williamson the prized scalp he was looking for. The budding partnership is over just after reaching 50.
Bouncer! It is on the body, Faf sways away from it.
FOUR! Faf looks to be in the mood today. He gets an overpitched ball on off, du Plessis gets on his front foot and drives it through covers to bring up the 50-run stand between the two.
On the stumps, Faf taps it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, Amla punches it through cover-point. The fielder from sweeper-cover mops it up and they get three.
Good length ball on the stumps, Hashim taps it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautifully driven! Full on middle, du Plessis strides out his front foot and drives it gorgeously through mid on for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
On the body, Amla flicks it towards square leg. The ball does not have the legs to reach the fence, they get three as the fielder cleans it up from mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Amla pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Amla leaves it alone.
Full on off, du Plessis strokes it to the left of mid off and gets off for a quick single. Williamson there gets to it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.

Full on off, Amla creams it past the diving point fielder and gets two. With that he gets to 8000 ODI runs. Becomes the second fastest player to reach this milestone after Virat Kohli. He did it in 175 innings, Amla is an innings late.
Good length ball on off, Amla punches it to the man at cover.
Good length ball on off, Faf looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man and du Plessis gets to the other end.
Full again on off, du Plessis pushes it to mid off.
Full on middle, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Ferguson bowls it full on off first up. Amla nudges it wide of cover and gets a single.
First bowling change of the game. Lockie Ferguson is into the attack.
Straight outside off, du Plessis leaves it alone. Another maiden for Henry in this game.
Length ball on middle and off, Faf defends it to mid off.
Better this. Good length ball just outside off, du Plessis looks to defend but the away movement takes it just past the outside edge.
Once again leaves the ball which is outside off. Just like a Test match, these two are taking their time out in the middle and setting themselves in.
Outside off, du Plessis is not going after those.
Good length ball on off, Faf taps it to the man at point.
Powerplay 2 is signaled. Maximum of four fielders can be outside the circle till the 40th over.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Amla looks to defend but misses it due to the seam movement on this one. South Africa at the end of Powerplay 1 are 40/1.
Good length delivery on middle, Amla defends it out.
Length delivery on off, du Plessis plays it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Second of the over. Good length ball on off, du Plessis gets on the front foot and this time smashes it through covers for a boundary.
On a good length and outside off, du Plessis lets it go.
FOUR! This should get du Plessis going. Fuller than a length on off, Faf gets on the front foot and drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Maiden for Henry. First maiden of the game. It is on a length outside off, Amla leaves it alone to get through the over.
Good length ball on the pads, Amla flicks it to mid-wicket. The fielder there misfields but that does not cost them any run.
Full now from Henry, Amla pushes it to mid on.
Straight outside off, left alone by HA.
Outside off on a length. There is a hint of away movement on this one. Amla lets it carry to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Hashim leaves it alone.

Good ball! Length ball on off, Amla looks to defend it with soft hands but it goes off the outside edge. It goes to first slip on a bounce and the batsmen take a quick run. The man at first slip has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length ball on off, Amla after two consecutive boundaries defends it.
FOUR! This is even better. Full on middle, Amla this time drives it sweetly past the diving mid off fielder to get the second boundary off the over.

FOUR! Crunched away! Boult overpitches it on off, Amla strides out and drives it exquisitely through covers for a boundary. It came right off the middle and the sound it made after connecting was just delicious.
Good length ball on off, Hashim defends it to cover.
Good length ball outside off, it goes away with angle. Amla leaves it alone.
Outside off and once again du Plessis leaves it alone to get through the over.

Oh, Henry almost got the better of du Plessis. Full on off, du Plessis looks to play the on drive but the ball moves away and flies past the outside edge towards the vacant slip region. It rolls to the left of third man. Lockie Ferguson at third man runs to his left and dives to stop the ball from going to the fence. He parries it away brilliantly. Saving two runs for his side.
No movement on this one now. Outside off and once again Faf has nothing to do with it.
Away swinger now. This is pitched on the fourth stump line, du Plessis does not fall in the trap to drive this and calmly shoulders arms to it.
Henry hits the deck hard on a length. This one comes in a bit after pitching, du Plessis looks to defend but he does so off the inner half of his bat.
Full on off, du Plessis pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Amla tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On off this time, Amla defends it with authority.

A very low full toss on the pads. Boult is getting a good amount of inswing here as this one also moved that way. Amla flicks it towards backward square leg. The fielder from fine leg mops it up and the batsmen take two.
Good length ball on middle, Amla gets behind it and blocks it.
Now Amla shuffles across and pushes this full ball to mid on.

Beauty of a delivery! Good length  ball pitching on leg. The ball comes in viciously after pitching. Amla looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. There was a stifled appeal but the ball was going down leg.
Third consecutive leave for the skipper. Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis does not bother to play at it.
On a good length and outside off, Faf lets it go.
Outside off, the skipper leaves it alone.
Length delivery on middle, Amla looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes through square leg. The batsmen get three runs.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Amla looks to drive but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
On a good length and outside off, Amla lets it go.
Length delivery on off, du Plessis taps it to point.
Outside off once again and du Plessis offers no stroke to it.
Length delivery on the fourth stump line, Faf leaves it alone.
On middle and leg, Amla tucks it towards square leg and gets a single.
Good length ball outside off, Amla lets it carry to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Amla taps it through point and gets a couple.
Bunny alert - This is the fifth occasion that Trent Boult has dismissed Quinton de Kock in ODIs. He has also got Shikhar Dhawan these many times.
Excellent finish to the over. On a good length and just outside off, du Plessis offers no shot.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis keeps it out.
On a good length on off, Amla looks to drive but gets an inside edge on this one. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Bowls a yorker on off, Amla does well to dig it out.
On a length on off, Amla plays it to off side.
Outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to this one.

Almost another calamity for South Africa. Full on off, du Plessis drives it through covers and runs hard. Kane Williamson gives the ball a chase and pulls it before the ropes. Du Plessis was on his bike for the third but Amla sends him back, Faf puts in a dive and in the end reaches safely as the throw from Williamson was first collected by the fielder at point. Good start for Boult. 6 runs and a wicket.
Faf du Plessis is the next batsman in.

OUT! The sweet sound of timber for the bowler! Brilliant start for New Zealand. Boult bowls it full on middle, the ball nips back in to the southpaw after hitting the deck, de Kock looks to play it straight but the ball goes right between his pad and bat. It crashes into the leg pole and sends it for a toss. The dangerous de Kock has to walk back and it is a nightmare of a start for South Africa.
On middle and leg, de Kock flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Boult is now guilty of straying it down the pads, de Kock just eases it down the fine leg region and gets his first boundary of the game.
Very full, almost a yorker. De Kock taps it to mid on once again.
Full on middle and off, de Kock pushes it to mid on.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other end.
Dot ball to finish the first over. Good length ball outside off, Hashim leaves it alone to see off the first over.

FOUR! Amla is off the mark in style. It is a poor ball on the pads, Amla just helps it down the fine leg region for a boundary. This is a very important game for Amla and South Africa need him to fire today.
Good length ball outside off, Amla starts his innings with a solid leave.
First run of the day. It is on the pads, de Kock flicks it towards backward square leg and gets himself and South Africa underway.
Play and a miss. Full outside off, going with the angle. De Kock looks to hit it through covers but misses.
Henry starts with a good length ball on top of off. De Kock defends it back to the bowler. No swing on the first ball.

Time to get underway. The umpires are out in the middle. The New Zealand players are in a huddle before they take their respective positions on the field. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock to open the innings for South Africa. Matt Henry will start the proceedings for New Zealand with the first new ball.

The players are out in the middle for their respective national anthems. First up it will be South Africa's followed by New Zealand's. We are not far away from the first ball being bowled in this game.

South Africa Playing XI - Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Faf du Plessis (C), Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Chris Morris, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi (IN for Beuran Hendricks), Imran Tahir.

New Zealand Playing XI (UNCHANGED) -  Martin Guptill, Colin Munro, Kane Williamson (C), Ross Taylor, Tom Latham (WK), Jimmy Neesham, Colin de Grandhomme, Mitchell Santner, Matt Henry, Lockie Ferguson, Trent Boult.

South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis says they would have bowled first as well as the pitch was under the cover. Says it's been a long time since they defeated New Zealand in the World Cup and reckons the Kiwis are a good side and they need to be at their best. On the last win, he says people might say it was just Afghanistan but it was very important to get the win and it was a complete performance. Informs Lungi Ngidi is back in the playing XI and he hopes that the big fast bowler will make an impact.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson says they are fielding first looking at the weather and says that the pitch won't change much. On his team, he says they are playing the same side. On whether the break was good, Williamson says they had a few days off which is important in this long tournament. On their record against South Africa in the World Cup, he replies it is irrelevant as South Africa are a good side and they need to play well today if they want to win.

TOSS - After a delay of more than an hour, we are ready for the toss. Both the captains along with the match referee are here for it. New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson has the coin in his hand. South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis calls Heads but it lands in favour of New Zealand. NEW ZEALAND OPT TO BOWL FIRST.

Welcome to the coverage of Match 25 of World Cup 2019. We are finally all set to get underway after all the delay due to the wet outfield. Just for your information, this is now a 49-overs-per-side game. Unbeaten New Zealand take on South Africa. A very important clash for both the sides for different reasons. A win here for New Zealand will take them back to the top of the table. The Kiwis come into this contest after having almost a week's rest. Kane Williamson's side has been excellent so far this tournament but this will be the real test for them after their clash against India was abandoned due to rain. South Africa, on the other hand, finally got a win in this tournament in their last fixture against Afghanistan. They have no time to relax as they need to win all their remaining fixtures to stay in the hunt for a place in the semi-finals. Faf du Plessis will be hoping his side can build on some momentum from the last encounter and stay alive in the tournament. An intriguing clash awaits us. Stay tuned for it as the toss is not far away.
